LanguageData.Raven_Drone_HeavyJetMkI.label: (Raven) Heavy Jet Drone Mk I
LanguageData.Raven_Drone_HeavyJetMkI.description: A combat drone that prioritizes hostile targets within its station's coverage. If no enemies are present, it automatically uses its jet to extinguish nearby fires.
LanguageData.Raven_Drone_HeavyRescueMedical.label: (Raven) Heavy Medical Rescue Drone
LanguageData.Raven_Drone_HeavyRescueMedical.descripti: A medical rescue drone designed to stabilize downed allies within its station's coverage and carry them to the nearest available bed.
